caption:
What would you say?

In a team meeting, someone rolled their eyes and said “Well, that makes no sense” right after you explained a new process. The room went quiet.

You’re about to speak with them right after the meeting.

What is your first sentence?

Ours goes in the comments on Monday.

#newmanager #leadership #management
monday_comment: Ours: “When you said ‘that makes no sense’ after I explained the new process, it shut the room down. I want to talk about what happened.”
